A question is followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the most appropriate answer. Question: Five friends, P, Q, R, S and T, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Who is sitting second to the left of T? Statements: (I) S sits second to the right of P. T sits to the immediate left of P. (II) Only one person sits between Q and R. P sits to the immediate left of R.

options.text: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.

questions.key_answer: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
